goal: After one independently verified D decode, extract its untouched CPU mesh and prepare eight camera-matched original/D pairs for human visual review.

files.scripts/compatibility/amd_zombie_d_compa: Default-dry-run entrypoint, dynamic provenance checks, scoped original CPU owner routing, paired review outputs.
GO/EOF-gated Blender CPU renderer using frozen original cameras and lighting, flat geometry with no modifiers.
files.scripts/compatibility/test_amd_zombie_d_: Synthetic provenance, row envelope, immutable original, ownership routing, audit and human-review tests.

interface: run(commit) -> exit code; CLI defaults to no-work dry run, execution requires --run --harness-commit <40 hex>.
stages: Validate published CPU source and successful D decode receipts, full ten-tensor hash closure, dynamic learned support <=1842968, input contract and D image lineage.
Verify immutable original PLY, mesh metadata and original eight view hashes; reserve absent private destination once.
Reuse the original owned CPU supervisor for a scoped extract worker; original amd_generation_mesh.py performs raw dual-grid extraction and exact PLY readback.
Render exactly eight CPU views with original camera locations, orthographic scales, target and lighting; no geometry changes or texture decoding.
Verify paired source/view hashes, create labeled contact sheet and full-size paired review page, and preserve explicit unassessed human visual rubric.
review_focus: Dynamic support cannot be replaced with historical zombie counts or a larger support profile.
PASS without independent ten tensors, natural owned settlement or exact current image lineage must stop before extraction.
Original and D cameras must match exactly, including location and orthographic scale; no per-mesh recentering or automatic fitting.
Original files remain immutable; all new outputs and temporary assets stay in the exclusive private directory.

Five separate visual criteria: fingers, toes, unintended holes, intended wound preservation and surface defects. Geometry counts and missing-neighbour counts are secondary evidence; never reward filling intended wounds.
limitations: No model loading, inference, WSL, real new mesh extraction or rendering is authorized for the preparation session.
CPU Cycles renders are an external runtime boundary; fixture verification does not claim a future real render has passed.
Matched full-body views can leave digits occluded or too small; human reviewers must mark those criteria unassessable instead of guessing.
secondary_C: Reuse authenticated completed C recovery PNGs only; no C generation, extraction or render.
visual_priorities: black speckles/unintended openings; do not infer topology from dark pixels
overall A body fidelity and surface defects
